name: CMB Stockfish Review Council
purpose: Review pull requests using independent specialist agents, adversarial challenge, deterministic scoring, and human-preserving arbitration.

search_model.position: changed files plus patches plus authority-sensitive paths
search_model.selection: deterministic principal-line selection followed by skeptic challenge

agents.role: Generate and rank candidate review lines.
Detect credential exposure, dangerous execution primitives, and security regressions.
Look for incomplete work, hidden failures, and correctness smells.
Evaluate change size, cohesion, maintainability, and recovery cost.
Search for weakened tests, skipped verification, and missing focused coverage signals.
Escalate security, policy, schema, workflow, and authority-sensitive changes.
Attack the leading candidate line and search for contradictions before approval.
Combine findings and votes into APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, or HUMAN_REVIEW.
